{{Top|leg}}
'''Counterpart encryption''' was a technique used to send coded messages between [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Counterpart/Legends|counterparts]]. One droid would send a highly complex encrypted signal which would be extremely difficult to decode for anyone but the counterpart.

*''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' {{Ab|Heir to the Empire (unabridged audiobook)}}
